This is looking really polished — I like how calm and clean it feels, and I can see it already handles adding, editing, favoriting, searching, collections, and sorting. Nice work.

Two things are holding me back from calling it done, though:

1. When I go to add a bookmark, it looks like I have to type in the title and description myself, and the little colored squares are just initials rather than the actual site icons. What I really pictured is: I paste in a link, and the app goes and fetches the page's title, description, and icon for me automatically so I barely have to type anything. That "just paste the link" convenience is honestly the main reason I wanted this — right now saving a link feels like filling out a form.

2. A big part of why I save links is to come back and read them later. I'd like to be able to mark a bookmark as "to read," and then see just those unread ones on their own, and check them off once I've read them.

Could you get those working? The rest of what you showed is close to what I had in mind.
